title: Release lore-cli 0.15.1 paired with quest-cli 0.15.1 (carries 0.15.0 scope and the DEC-282 fixes)
description: DEC-282 (a5)/(a6), DEC-290 (a4): ONE release, 0.15.1, carrying 0.15.0's existing scope (ODOC-556, LCLI-775) and the cont1 fixes. 0.15.0 stays only as release-candidate 0.15.0-rc.1 and is never moved to latest. Supersedes LCLI-775 as the release task (LCLI-775 keeps its hold label). Order: quest bump first, lore bump pinned to quest's dev tip on BOTH QUEST_SOURCE_REF pins, then dry run only after quest main reads 0.15.1 and its rc is staged. npm token pre-check passed 2026-11-21 16:26:03Z (npm whoami exit 0); token created 2026-09-14 and expires on or about 2026-12-13 under the 90-day cap, so the release after this one mints a new token first. LCLI-771's operator Windows check is operator-only and does not gate the publish. Registry publication is tier 3: the operator's own dialog only. Do not promote dev to main, tag or publish without the leader's further go.
